title: Figure 3: aeronautical sectional chart of Brownwood 1 East MOA near Dublin, Texas
description: Google Earth image of an aeronautical sectional chart showing airports, airways and the Brownwood 1 East Military Operations Area around Dublin and Stephenville, Texas, with sighting markers overlaid. Caption: "Figure 3 Brownwood 1 East MOA is over most of the sighting area and close to the rest. It might be noted that flight routes and power transmission lines are in the area." Text above discusses witness timing and a report of helicopters conducting exercises between Dublin and Stephenville.
